shell.purpose: Sidebar shell and mobile top bar; browser theme-color.

act.purpose: Actions and the forecast's instruments: buttons, links, caret, focus, confidence dots, route progress, calibration.

act-hover.purpose: Hover state of Action Blue fills.

act-soft.purpose: Selected platform chip fill, angle tags.

act-ink.purpose: Text on Action Blue (primary buttons, skip link) and the tick in the checked platform chip's Action Blue circle.

cold.purpose: Thermal scale: scores below 40; band Bas 50 %.

mild.purpose: Thermal scale: scores 40-59; band Top 50 %; shell warning dot.

tepid.purpose: Thermal scale: scores 60-74; format-flag bullets, notice border tint.

warm.purpose: Thermal scale: scores 75-84; band Top 25 %; the brand's sun (brand mark, active nav icon, selection, onboarding final station).

hot.purpose: Thermal scale: scores 85+; band Top 10 %; warm-front glyph.

thermal-ink.purpose: Text on cold, mild, tepid and warm fills.

hot-ink.purpose: Text on hot fills (white by day, dark ink at night).

ok.purpose: Matched forecast, saved, format OK, done run stages (with a Bulletin Paper tick), Réécrit stamp.

ok-soft.purpose: Background of the Juste match badge.

warn-ink.purpose: One band off, notices, format flags, Priorité tag.

err.purpose: Field errors, alerts, band misses, over-length tweets.

sky.purpose: Page ground; deep navy at night.

surface.purpose: Cards, bulletin, inputs, secondary buttons; the tick on a done run stage's Verified Green dot.

surface-2.purpose: Side panel, open history detail, secondary-button hover.

surface-3.purpose: Skeletons, empty tracks, quiet hover, pending reading.

line-strong.purpose: Hover borders, route line, empty chip outlines, dashed provisional borders, scrollbar thumb.

ink-2.purpose: Secondary text, verdict sentence, meta; small text on Cold Sky, Paper Wash and the band-tinted verdict strip.

ink-3.purpose: Tertiary meta and labels on Bulletin Paper and Paper Shade. Never on Cold Sky, Paper Wash or the verdict strip. Elsewhere on Cold Sky, Paper Wash and the band-tinted strip Slate Ink takes its place, and Shell Ink Dim on the shell.

ink-on-shell-2.purpose: Shell labels, the status line and the hollow chip of a recent forecast with no score.

shell-active.purpose: Wash behind the current nav item on the shell; fixed by day and night.

status-ready.purpose: Shell status dot when the connection is ready; fixed, the shell is always dark.

status-error.purpose: Shell status dot when the connection fails; fixed, the shell is always dark.

shell-night.purpose: Night value of Map Blue under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

act-night.purpose: Night value of Action Blue under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

act-hover-night.purpose: Night value of Action Blue Deep under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

act-soft-night.purpose: Night value of Action Wash under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

act-ink-night.purpose: Night value of Action Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

cold-night.purpose: Night value of Cold under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

mild-night.purpose: Night value of Mild under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

tepid-night.purpose: Night value of Tepid under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

warm-night.purpose: Night value of Warm under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

hot-night.purpose: Night value of Hot under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

thermal-ink-night.purpose: Night value of Thermal Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

hot-ink-night.purpose: Night value of Hot Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ok-night.purpose: Night value of Verified Green under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ok-soft-night.purpose: Night value of Verified Wash under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

warn-ink-night.purpose: Night value of Rust Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

warn-soft-night.purpose: Night value of Rust Wash under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

err-night.purpose: Night value of Alert Red under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

err-soft-night.purpose: Night value of Alert Wash under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

sky-night.purpose: Night value of Cold Sky under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

surface-night.purpose: Night value of Bulletin Paper under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

surface-2-night.purpose: Night value of Paper Shade under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

surface-3-night.purpose: Night value of Paper Wash under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

line-night.purpose: Night value of Chart Rule under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

line-2-night.purpose: Night value of Faint Rule under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

line-strong-night.purpose: Night value of Strong Rule under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ink-night.purpose: Night value of Deep Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ink-2-night.purpose: Night value of Slate Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ink-3-night.purpose: Night value of Mist Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ink-on-shell-night.purpose: Night value of Shell Ink under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ink-on-shell-2-night.purpose: Night value of Shell Ink Dim under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

shell-hi-night.purpose: Night value of Shell Highlight under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

display.purpose: The score in the verdict's reading block; display-phone at 640px and below. One per screen.

display-phone.purpose: The reading at 640px and below, in an 88px block.

headline.purpose: « Top 25 % de ta niche »; headline-phone on phones.

title-page.purpose: Page h1, balanced; title-page-phone on phones.

headline-phone.purpose: The band title at 640px and below.

title-flow.purpose: The idea heading the result screen; 22px on phones.

title-script.purpose: The script's own title, opening the script above its meta line (always on YouTube); angle titles step down to 18px.

title-section.purpose: Section heads, running-forecast title, empty-state headings.

script.purpose: The script to publish, max 66ch; 16.5px on phones. Largest running text on screen.

verdict.purpose: Slate Ink within 52ch, its lead clause in Deep Ink 500; 15.5px on phones.

tweet.purpose: Each tweet of an X thread, within 64ch.

lede.purpose: Page lede under an h1, within 64ch; the Radar search query also sets at 16px.

title-card.purpose: Onboarding station titles and Radar source titles.

body-large.purpose: Large button, Reels caption, history idea, the verdict sentence on phones.

body.purpose: Interface text; the secondary steps body-large to fine carry the meta.

field.purpose: Text inputs, textareas and selects at 15px/1.45; the idea field 18px/1.5.

body-small.purpose: Buttons (500), station text, improvements, alerts, trend-front titles (600).

meta.purpose: Flow meta line, factor rows, notices, the toast.

meta-small.purpose: Recents, the script meta line, the verdict's meta rows, field errors, suggestion chips, on the body's 1.5 leading; trend-front reasons set 13.5px/1.45.

help.purpose: Help text, the « relevé à venir » link, the tabs hint, history sub-lines, on the body's 1.5 leading; format flags and the empty recents line set 13px/1.45.

fine.purpose: Route labels, the status line, side notes, signal counts; source names and tweet lengths at 12px. On the body's 1.5 leading, except side notes (1.45), the status line (1.35) and a signal count inside a Radar row (the row's 1.4).

label.purpose: Uppercase. Names the field, value or group directly beside or below it; never above a heading. Mist Ink on paper, Slate Ink on the band-tinted verdict strip.

numeral.purpose: Thermal chips (13px small); clocks at 30px and 18px in weight 600.

themes.dark: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) redefines every colour and shadow token; each colour's night value is its frontmatter `<token>-night` twin (colorMeta.<token>.nightToken), each shadow's in shadows[].night

thermal.priorityPick: lowest factor score, first on ties
thermal.recommendedAngle: max score_tendance (first on ties) gets the primary « Écrire cet angle » and the « Le plus porté » tag; « Angle actuel » replaces the tag when it is the current angle

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Hairline rest: cards, bulletin, angle cards, history entries.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Lift: hovered angle card (fine pointers, with -2px translate) and the toast.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Text inputs, the select and the median and stat inputs on focus; the Radar search field rings its whole card on focus-within at 20%. Other controls: outline 2px solid var(--act), offset 2px.

shadows.name: route-current-halo
shadows.purpose: Current station on the route stepper.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Movement: press, toast, chevrons, view entrances, sticky bar, card lift, live signals and the bulletin drop. Colour and border changes use the CSS `ease` keyword instead.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The needle sliding to its band.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Hover colour and border changes (on `ease`) and the button press (on ease-out).

motion.name: t-ui
motion.purpose: Disclosure chevrons, toast, confidence dot fill, rewrite blur, the onboarding route's final-station fill.

motion.name: t-move
motion.purpose: View entrances (rise 8px), sticky bar slide, live signals.

motion.name: bulletin-drop
motion.value: reading 460ms drop -12px scale .96 + count-up 900ms; title/verdict rise 180/260ms; needle 720ms ease-in-out from 240ms; confidence dots 220ms from 480ms +90ms; factor bars scaleX 560ms from 320ms +60ms; improvements rise from 640ms +70ms; tab chips 240ms from 200ms +60ms
motion.purpose: « Le bulletin tombe »: the one authored moment, once per forecast. Reduced motion: opacity 0.4 to 1 over 200ms.

motion.name: rewrite
motion.value: script blur(2px) opacity .5 while working; clear 260ms; numeral counts old to new 700ms; factor bars regrow scaleX .6→1 420ms (+50ms); « Réécrit » stamp rises 4px 240ms from 120ms

motion.name: route-draw
motion.value: segments scaleX 0→1 from the left, 640ms ease-out, +160ms per station (scaleY from the top at 640px and below); final station fills Warm over 200ms ease, 360ms after its stagger slot
motion.purpose: « Comment Amorce prévoit »: once, as the onboarding route scrolls into view; the stations' text is visible throughout and never animates.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations 1ms (spinner stops); view transitions off; view entrances 160ms fade; press scale off; sticky bar fades (200ms); onboarding route shown drawn with its Warm final station, no transition; verdict strip opacity 0.4→1 200ms; rewrite: script opacity 0.5→1 200ms, no count-up; smooth scroll → auto

breakpoints.name: wide-max
breakpoints.purpose: Reading column 112px; verdict meta drops below in two columns; side panel 330px; running-forecast side stacks.

breakpoints.name: tablet-max
breakpoints.purpose: Shell becomes a sticky top bar (brand name, status text and recents hidden; nav links 38px tall, 11px side padding); content top padding 24px; bulletin body single column; flow head stacks.

breakpoints.name: phone-max
breakpoints.purpose: Icon-only nav; 88px reading, 15.5px verdict sentence, verdict padding 18px with 16px gaps; script and side panel padding 18px; tabs 14px without hint; sticky bar drops its score switch and button labels; route collapses to bare stations; onboarding route turns vertical and draws top-down.

components.css: .ds-shell{display:grid;gap:2px;width:236px;padding:22px 14px 18px;background:var(--shell, #0C315C);color:var(--ink-on-shell, #C6D6EB);font:400 15px/1.5 "Fira Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;}.ds-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 8px 22px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;}.ds-brand-mark{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--warm, #F08A24);color:#0D2240;font:700 17px/1 "Fira Sans Condensed", "Fira Sans", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif;}.ds-brand-name{font:600 19px/1 "Fira Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.01em;}.ds-nav-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink-on-shell, #C6D6EB);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:var(--shell-hi, rgba(255,255,255,.12));color:#fff;}.ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;}.ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] .ds-ico{color:var(--warm, #F08A24);}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--act, #1C57B0);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-ico{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.75;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

components.description: Pill toggle for choosing platforms on the brief; hover takes a Strong Rule border; checked fills the circle Action Blue with an Action Ink tick.
components.css: .ds-pf-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}.ds-pf{position:relative;}.ds-pf input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;}.ds-pf>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;height:42px;padding:0 14px 0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line, #D2DEEC);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface, #FFFFFF);color:var(--ink-2, #3B5373);font:500 15px/1 "Fira Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;}.ds-check{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line-strong, #9DB6D6);display:grid;place-items:center;}.ds-check svg{width:10px;height:10px;stroke:var(--act-ink, #FFFFFF);stroke-width:3;fill:none;opacity:0;}.ds-pf:hover>span{border-color:var(--line-strong, #9DB6D6);}.ds-pf input:checked+span{border-color:var(--act, #1C57B0);background:var(--act-soft, #E3ECF9);color:var(--ink, #0D2240);}.ds-pf input:checked+span .ds-check{background:var(--act, #1C57B0);box-shadow:none;}.ds-pf input:checked+span .ds-check svg{opacity:1;}.ds-pf input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--act, #1C57B0);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Platform Tabs with Thermal Chips
components.description: Result tabs; each carries its score as a small thermal chip coloured by its own value. The selected tab joins the bulletin sheet. An unjudged tab shows the hollow chip, its « — » in Slate Ink over a Mist Ink ring.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;position:relative;z-index:1;}.ds-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:48px;padding:0 14px 0 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-bottom:0;border-radius:11px 11px 0 0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2, #3B5373);font:500 15px/1 "Fira Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--ink, #0D2240);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface, #FFFFFF) 55%,transparent);}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--surface, #FFFFFF);border-color:var(--line, #D2DEEC);color:var(--ink, #0D2240);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:-1px;height:49px;}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--act, #1C57B0);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-t{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:28px;height:22px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--t,var(--mild, #F2C845));color:var(--thermal-ink, #0D2240);font:700 13px/1 "Fira Sans Condensed", "Fira Sans", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-t-hot{color:var(--hot-ink, #FFFFFF);}.ds-t-empty{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong, #9DB6D6);color:var(--ink-3, #5C7392);}.ds-tab .ds-t-empty{color:var(--ink-2, #3B5373);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-3, #5C7392);}.ds-sheet{height:24px;background:var(--surface, #FFFFFF);border:1px solid var(--line, #D2DEEC);border-radius:0 14px 14px 14px;}

components.name: Bulletin Verdict Band
components.description: Signature strip: reading block in the score's heat, band title and verdict, then the four-segment scale with its clip-path needle and the observed reading's hollow ring, five confidence dots capped at four, and Prévu · relevé (arrow icon, the ring as legend key, match badge). Every label inside the strip is Slate Ink, the judging clock included. An unjudged platform closes the strip with an evaluation prompt as a ruled row (1px rule in the band mix, no fill or radius) holding « Lancer l'évaluation ».

narrative.overview:
Amorce reads like a weather bulletin for content. A score is a forecast, not a grade: a reading set on a thermal scale, a probability band (« Top 25 % de ta niche »), a confidence index, and a slot that waits for the observed reading which later verifies it (« Prévu · relevé »). Every screen is assembled from the instruments of a forecast — the thermometer block, the four-segment band scale with its needle, five confidence dots, the cartographic warm-front symbol for trends, and the route line that strings the steps of a forecast like weather stations. The world deliberately refuses the generic grey gauge dashboard and the "AI" look of violet gradients and sparkles; its colours come from the map and the thermometer.

The frame is a map-blue shell around a cold sky ground by day and a deep-blue night by night; the theme follows the device. Paper-white surfaces sit on the sky as flat tonal layers carrying a hairline shadow. Density is that of a working tool: 40px controls, 8–16px gaps inside groups, 28px between panel columns. The script being read is the largest running text on every screen, because the content is the product. Readings are set in Fira Sans Condensed, with tabular figures on scores, thermal chips and clocks; prose, headings and meta figures are set in Fira Sans.

Motion is a single authored moment per forecast, « le bulletin tombe »: the reading drops in and counts up, the needle slides to its band, the confidence dots light one by one, the factor bars fill. Before any forecast, the onboarding route traces itself once as it scrolls into view: its stations' text is already in place, only the line between the stations draws, segment after segment, and the final station then fills Warm. Everything else is quiet: colour and border changes take 140ms on `ease` (200ms for the confidence fill and the rewrite blur); movement (press, toast, chevrons, view entrances, sticky bar) takes 140–260ms on the exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1). View changes cross-fade (out 120ms, in 240ms rising 6px). Reduced motion is honoured as less and softer, never as nothing: all CSS animations collapse to 1ms (the busy spinner stops), view transitions are off, view entrances become a 160ms fade, presses don't scale, the sticky bar fades, smooth scrolling jumps, the onboarding route is shown already drawn with its Warm final station, the verdict strip fades 40%→100% over 200ms, and a rewrite only fades the script from 50% to full over 200ms with no count-up.
keyCharacteristics: A five-step thermal scale (cold, mild, tepid, warm, hot) codes every potential value and every band; Warm doubles as the brand's sun.
Map-blue shell, cold-sky ground, paper surfaces; night is deep blue, never black.
Confidence is five dots and tops out at four: a forecast is never certain.
Step progress is a route line with stations, not a bar or a ring.
The warm-front glyph marks every retained trend and live signal.
Fira Sans for prose and meta, Fira Sans Condensed for readings; scores, chips, clocks and counted meta in tabular figures.
Flat at rest; lift only on hover or for a transient message.

rules.name: The Thermal Scale Rule
rules.body: A potential value is coloured by its own value and nothing else: 85 and above hot, 75 warm, 60 tepid, 40 mild, below 40 cold. A band is coloured by its band: Top 10 % hot, Top 25 % warm, Top 50 % mild, Bas 50 % cold. The verdict strip mixes its band colour into the paper at 11% (24% at night) and rules its edges at 26% (42% at night). With no band yet (pending or judging), the strip is tinted and ruled with Strong Rule instead of a thermal colour.

rules.name: The Blue Instrument Rule
rules.body: Action Blue carries interaction and the forecast's own instruments: confidence, route progress, calibration. It never encodes potential, and a thermal colour never marks an action.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: The only non-data use of a thermal hue is Warm as the brand's sun: the brand mark, the active nav icon, text selection (Warm at 35%), and the final station of the onboarding route, « Le bulletin avant publication ». Every other thermal colour on screen is a score, a band, a trend front, or a warning marker.

rules.name: The Night Bulletin Rule
rules.body: Every colour token is redefined under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` (its `-night` twin); night is deep blue, never black. Components reference `var(--token)`, except deliberate fixed values on the always-dark shell (white text, the Shell Active wash, the Ready Green and Error Coral status dots) and the brand mark's #0D2240 « A ». Ticks are tokens too, never #FFFFFF: Action Ink on the Action Blue check circle, Bulletin Paper on the Verified Green dot of a done run stage.

rules.name: The Condensed Reading Rule
rules.body: Fira Sans Condensed sets readings: scores, thermal chips, band titles, clocks, scale labels, labels. Fira Sans sets prose, headings and meta figures. Scores, thermal chips, clocks and tweet numbers carry tabular figures in the condensed cut; the Fira Sans meta figures that change or line up (calibration %, tweet length, script measure, signal counts, the stat and median inputs) take tabular-nums too; the confidence and route « n/5 », the improvement counters, dates and view counts are plain figures.

rules.name: The Script First Rule
rules.body: The script to publish is the largest running text on the screen (18px/1.62, at most 66ch); the verdict sentence (17px), the lede (16px) and interface text (15px) step down from it.

rules.name: The Label Names Its Neighbour Rule
rules.body: The uppercase condensed label names the field, value or group directly beside or below it. It never sits above a heading to introduce it.

rules.name: The Route Rule
rules.body: Step progress is a route: a 2px Strong Rule line threading 12–14px station dots. Completed dots and segments fill Action Blue and the current station wears a 4px Action Blue halo at 18%. On the onboarding route the final station is Warm and the first segment is drawn as a warm front. Steps are never drawn as a progress bar or a ring.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat with the hairline shadow. Lift is a response to hover or a transient message, never a resting state. The one translucent surface is the sticky action bar (paper at 92% with `saturate(1.4) blur(10px)`), which needs it to stay legible over scrolled content.

rules.name: The Attached Tab Rule
rules.body: The bulletin's top-left corner is square (0 14px 14px 14px) so the selected platform tab, with 11px top corners, no bottom border and a 1px overlap, reads as one sheet with it.

rules.name: The Dashed Provisional Rule
rules.body: A dashed 1px Strong Rule border marks what is not measured yet: the « relevé à venir » link and the « Exemple » tag on demonstration data.

dos: Do colour every potential number by its own value with the thermal thresholds (85 hot, 75 warm, 60 tepid, 40 mild, below cold) and every band by its band (Top 10 % hot, Top 25 % warm, Top 50 % mild, Bas 50 % cold).
Do set text on cold, mild, tepid and warm fills in Thermal Ink, and on hot in Hot Ink.
Do show confidence as five Action Blue dots: faible 2/5, moyenne 3/5, haute 4/5.
Do pair every forecast with its observed reading: a hollow ring on the band scale once entered, a dashed « relevé à venir » until then.
Do mark retained trends and live signals with the warm-front glyph in Hot.
Do draw step progress as a route line with stations (2px line, 12–14px dots, Action Blue when done).

Do use `var(--token)` for every colour so the night bulletin follows the device; the shell's fixed whites, Shell Active wash and status dots and the brand mark's « A » are the only literals, and ticks take a token, never #FFFFFF (Action Ink on Action Blue, Bulletin Paper on Verified Green).

Do set every reading in Fira Sans Condensed with tabular figures on scores, chips and clocks, and give meta figures that change or line up (calibration %, tweet length, script measure, signal counts) tabular-nums.

Do keep Mist Ink (#5C7392) for text on Bulletin Paper and Paper Shade (4.86:1, 4.56:1); on Cold Sky (4.23:1), Paper Wash (4.35:1) and the band-tinted verdict strip (4.13:1 on Top 10 %) use Slate Ink, and on the shell use Shell Ink Dim.

Do keep « le bulletin tombe » as the one authored moment of a forecast; on the onboarding route only the line draws on scroll, over text that is already there; give reduced motion a short fade or the finished drawing rather than nothing.
donts: Don't paint a score, band or bar with a colour its value did not earn, and don't use a thermal hue on chrome beyond Warm's brand uses and the warning markers (the Mild status dot, Tepid flag bullets and the Tepid notice border).
Don't fill the fifth confidence dot or present a score as a promise of views.
Don't reach for violet gradients, sparkles or a grey gauge dial: the instruments are the thermometer, the band scale and the front.
Don't put an uppercase label above a heading or a script as a kicker or eyebrow; a heading stands on its own, and a script's state is a sentence-case meta line below its title.

Don't nest a card in a card: trend fronts, tweets and Radar items are rows ruled by a 1px Faint Rule. Inside the bulletin only the weakest factor's row is raised on paper, as an emphasised row without shadow; the evaluation prompt is a ruled row.
Don't render step progress as a progress bar or a ring.

Don't use Unicode characters or emoji as icons, « → » included: the « Prévu · relevé » connector is the arrow icon. Interface icons are 24px-grid SVG strokes at 1.75px with round caps and joins (ticks inside 16–18px check circles at 3), and the cartographic warm-front glyph is the one authored symbol on its own 34 × 14 grid.
Don't make night black; it is deep blue.
Don't give a surface a resting lift or a hard offset shadow; depth is tonal, shadows are offset and soft.
